claims.head: Strength against strength
claims.body: The Panthers are one of the league’s best for the power play, but the Senators are one of the best at the penalty kill. Our lean: the Panthers’ power play wins out. Power plays usually beat kills in these spots. The Senators take a lot of penalties and the Panthers draw plenty of them, so their power play should get its chances.
claims.call: The Panthers’ power play creates more than the league-average 7.6 expected goals per 60 against the Senators.
claims.nums: Florida 5th for the power play (8.5 expected goals per 60) · Ottawa 5th for the penalty kill

claims.head: Tkachuk gets company tonight
claims.call: The Senators’ L4 (Cousins, Amadio and Pinto) spends at least 57% of its 5-on-5 time against the Panthers’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Senators keep sending Pinto’s line (Cousins, Amadio and Pinto) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Travis Green has been using this group as a checking line on the other team’s top line. Tonight the Panthers’ first line is Bennett, M. Tkachuk and B. Tkachuk.
claims.nums: At home: 57% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 35% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Travis Green likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Panthers’ first line.

notes.text: Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 6 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 4 games.
Jake Sanderson is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 7 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Thomas Chabot has taken his spot beside Artem Zub.
William Eklund is out 10-12 weeks and has missed the last 4 games.
Artem Zub returned in their last game after missing 4 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Artem Zub was added to the roster on Oct 16 and has played beside Thomas Chabot.
Jordan Spence has started killing penalties: on the ice for 39% of the team’s shorthanded time in 8 games, up from 4% last season.

OTT.head: The Senators start a half-step ahead
OTT.body: Even though Ottawa may be without Sanderson, the Senators have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage, and Florida will be without Barkov. Still, it’s close: the Panthers can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

FLA.head: A slightly uphill night for the Panthers
FLA.body: Even though Ottawa may be without Sanderson, the Senators have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage, and Florida will be without Barkov. The Panthers can tip it if they keep shots to a minimum.

story.head: Brady Tkachuk returns to Ottawa
paras: The Senators are 6-2-0. The Panthers have won two in a row.

It’s strength against strength: the Panthers are one of the league’s best for the power play, but the Senators are one of the best at the penalty kill. At home, Travis Green likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Cats’ first line.

items.text: Brady Tkachuk faces Ottawa for the first time since leaving.
Drake Batherson has a point in five straight games against Florida, with a goal in each of the last four.
The Panthers have been without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games.
The Senators have been without Jake Sanderson, Jonas Johansson and William Eklund for several games. Linus Ullmark is expected to start.
